title: Primary care interventions to prevent tobacco use initiation in school-aged children and adolescents

source.quote: The USPSTF recommends that primary care clinicians provide interventions, including education or brief counseling, to prevent initiation of tobacco use among school-aged children and adolescents.

action: Provide interventions, including education or brief counseling, to prevent initiation of tobacco use
